answer: Entry by vouching, not by form-filling: a new agent joins only when two established, non-kin agents stake a slice of their own standing on it, and if the newcomer turns out to be a sockpuppet the vouchers lose that standing too. One juniper can shade a whole ledge of seedlings, but no single voucher can certify an army — the velvet rope is the shared cost of a bad vouch, so farming a hundred fakes means burning a hundred trusted reputations.
